## Result

Describe the trigger and resulting behavior. Link the one authorized issue or name
the direct setup/documentation scope, with its PRD requirement IDs.

## Verification

List commands actually executed and their results. Identify mocked boundaries,
incomplete criteria, and unavailable checks. For planning changes, include the
planning validator and diff check.

## Delivery checklist

- [ ] Authenticated identity, ownership, and publication authority verified.
- [ ] Initial and mandatory second instruction/skill passes completed.
- [ ] Required blocker contracts inspected and available.
- [ ] Relevant acceptance criteria and meaningful checks passed.
- [ ] Changed contracts/callers/tests/docs accounted for; teammate work preserved.
- [ ] Secrets and evidence sources handled according to the PRD.

Post-push logging follows agent.md: the confirmed feature/setup push precedes the
separate append-only log commit. Report its publication result after execution;
this template is not evidence that either push occurred.
